design_condition: The raised volume negotiates between high-rise neighbours and the smaller existing school while shaping a green transition between settlement and landscape.

positive.statement: The clear urban-development stance convincingly responds to the scale of the surrounding area.
The landscape concept creates a flowing, diverse and climatically pleasant open-space sequence.
The arrangement of public uses enables good orientation and flexible use.
The project is consistently developed from a strong urban concept and has a high level of completion.

negative.statement: The large form comes very close to the smaller school and literally overshadows it.
The path connections are well resolved, but a certain spatial generosity is missing.
The open concept is problematic for fire protection because escape stairs occupy the central access area.
The dense arrangement of classrooms makes circulation scarce and cluster zoning only partially successful.
The exclusive skylight lighting of the internal group rooms is questioned.
The proposed facade greening is technically and operationally complex to maintain.
The underground structure significantly restricts the integration of trees into the open space.
